# WHO releases AI ethics and governance guidance for large multi-modal models

[中文](https://www.who.int/zh/news/item/18-01-2024-who-releases-ai-ethics-and-governance-guidance-for-large-multi-modal-models)

[Français](https://www.who.int/fr/news/item/18-01-2024-who-releases-ai-ethics-and-governance-guidance-for-large-multi-modal-models)

[Русский](https://www.who.int/ru/news/item/18-01-2024-who-releases-ai-ethics-and-governance-guidance-for-large-multi-modal-models)

[Español](https://www.who.int/es/news/item/18-01-2024-who-releases-ai-ethics-and-governance-guidance-for-large-multi-modal-models)

The World Health Organization (WHO) is releasing new guidance on the [ethics and governance of large multi-modal models](https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240084759) (LMMs) – a type of fast growing generative artificial intelligence (AI) technology with applications across health care.
